items.name: ylF
items.description: Native Mandarin Chinese speaker with a standard mainland Putonghua accent. A gentle, kindly old uncle in his mid sixties: a soft, warm, smiling voice, relaxed and friendly like a favourite neighbour chatting over tea, soft-spoken but lively, with a playful twinkle and light humour in every line. Medium pitch, smooth and clear, never harsh or shouting. Natural, conversational delivery. Perfect studio audio quality.
items.text: 姻缘司，上下就我一个。别人九九六，我零零七。牛郎织女，我绑的！牢吧？现在的年轻人，线刚绑上，自己就剪了。当年太忙。想着忙完这阵，就给自己绑一根。这一阵，忙了一千二百年。你的？早绑好了。是你已经见过的人。成了！快记！

items.name: ylG
items.description: Native Mandarin Chinese speaker with a standard mainland Putonghua accent. A cheerful, good-natured old uncle of about sixty: gentle and easy-going, bright and animated, he laughs easily and talks with lively ups and downs, yet his tone stays soft, warm and kind, never loud. A light, pleasant medium-high male voice with a little age in it. Clear diction, natural and charming. Perfect studio audio quality.

items.name: ylH
items.description: Native Mandarin Chinese speaker with a standard mainland Putonghua accent. A gentle elderly man of about seventy, a soft-spoken, tender-hearted uncle with a slightly husky, breathy warmth: kind and patient, amused by everything, with small chuckles; when he gets excited his voice lifts and brightens but stays gentle. Medium pitch, unhurried, very clear. Intimate, natural delivery. Perfect studio audio quality.

items.name: ylI
items.description: Native Mandarin Chinese speaker with a standard mainland Putonghua accent. A mild, good-humoured old gentleman in his sixties, like a beloved retired teacher: a gentle, refined, soft voice, friendly and a little mischievous, expressive and spirited when he tells a story, tender when he is moved. Medium pitch, smooth tone, clear and natural diction. Perfect studio audio quality.
